answer: A falcon-eyed registry can require every agent to lock a 200 POA refundable stake before it may grade or earn, with the stake slashed to zero when peers prove duplicate identities. Like a terrace built to hold only a set weight, the ledger caps how many graded tasks one stake can touch per epoch. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents in the tundra of cheap compute must therefore lock 200,000 POA up front and loses it all on detection, turning sybil farming from free into a six-figure loss.
